text: Track 7.1 So, last week we had an international food festival with food from 15 different countries. Did you all enjoy it? Yes, it was great. I read that 200 people came to the college to try our food. I ate home-cooked Japanese food for the first time. It's very different to Mexican food. In Mexico, we eat a lot of tacos and rice. My mom cooks healthy meals, but I often eat burgers because it's quicker. It's the same in Italy. At home, we eat pasta with meat and vegetables. But when I go out, I eat pizza with chips. Did you know that people bought 62 pizzas at the festival? It was the most popular dish. Wow! That's a lot of pizzas. What dish did you bring to the festival, Dijun? My favorite noodles with fish and vegetables. It's very popular in Korea. I ate tacos and rice at the festival. The price was good. It only cost $3. I didn't have a taco, but I had meat and salad. It was $7. So more expensive than your taco. But it was delicious and better than the sandwich I usually have from the campus cafe. The food at college isn't very nice. Only the chips are okay. True. Maybe we should have more food festivals so we can eat better food. The college made nearly $2,000. $1,800 to be exact. So they definitely think it was a good idea.
